doc: Targets for a believable, varied, stable person. Each metric has a band [lo,hi]; inside = 0 penalty, outside = ((distance)/width)^2 * weight. 'hard' metrics must hold on every validation block or the set is rejected.

loo_share.note: toilet visits are a small share of acts

zero_sleep_days.note: fraction of days with no sleep

chain_broken_ratio.note: chains that break / chains that end. FINAL target ~0.35: real life interrupts routines often, but every break must branch

chain_branch_ratio.note: share of broken chains that continue into another sequence (branch/resume); the rest are dead ends

valence_day_sd.note: day-to-day mood variation inside one life

stress_runaway_days.note: fraction of days whose peak stress exceeds 0.97 for the whole day (mean>0.9)

between_life_sd.note: different seeds should be recognisably different lives, but one personality

social_acts_per_day.note: phone, letters, visitors, snake: social contact is a real part of the day

art_satisfied_share.note: serene satisfaction after a piece is RARE; those are the good pieces

art_skill.note: skill after the sweep horizon (short runs: lower bound is gentle)

atus_gap.note: sum of absolute class minute-share gaps vs ATUS (pct points), persona classes excluded
